purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Официальные материалы Республики Дагестан указывают региональные подразделения Росреестра и Роскадастра в Махачкале. В 2026 году филиал Роскадастра внес обновленные сведения о границе населенного пункта Махачкалы в ЕГРН/НСПД; это не слой земельных участков и не подтверждение городского покрытия кадастровыми полигонами.
registryAssessment: Official Dagestan Ministry of Land and Property Relations notice for cadastral-complex work in city cadastral quarter 05:40:000019 names the regional Rosreestr office and Roskadastr branch at Makhachkala addresses and identifies the Makhachkala city administration as the map-plan approval authority. This is direct city-specific cadastral work, but consultation/objections require identity and rights documents. The regional offices have Republic of Dagestan remit; this does not establish municipality-only parcel coverage. No anonymous geometry-only route or safe attribute allowlist was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Dagestan Ministry notice documents KKR project quarter 05:40:000019 within Makhachkala city district, city-government authority and Makhachkala office locations; map-plan inspection/objections require identity and rights documents.

Roskadastr Dagestan regional service page lists regional service offices at Akushinsky 5V and Nauchnaya 8 in Makhachkala. The office serves the republic region; no municipality-only coverage is inferred.

Official Dagestan Ministry of Land and Property Relations KKR notice identifies the regional Rosreestr administration and regional Roskadastr branch as responsible participants and gives Makhachkala contact/office locations; the notice’s work area is Buynaksk, not Makhachkala.

2026 report says the Dagestan Roskadastr branch entered updated Makhachkala settlement boundary information into EGRN and made it available on NSPD. This is boundary evidence, not cadastral parcel geometry.
Federal National Spatial Data System map is the destination cited for the updated settlement boundary. The public map page timed out in the web reader; no status or feature schema was established.

accessReview.reason: An official 2026 Dagestan Ministry notice documents cadastral-complex work for a quarter within the Makhachkala city district and lists official government/registry locations for consulting the project map plan. Participation and objections require personal identity and land-right documents, so no such submission or feature request was made. The official NSPD public map URL was attempted in the web reader but timed out without HTTP status; no schema or geometry was exposed. Do not treat the city cadastral-work notice or updated settlement boundary as proof of full parcel-layer coverage.

privacy: No owner/address/tax/account/property-record query, login, or private attribute extraction was performed. No geometry retained.
